desc:
Nothing says upland hunting better than an open field, a loyal dog, a well-worn vest, and a fine over and under shotgun emblazoned with the name Browning. From the pheasant fields to the sporting clays range, the Citori 825 Field is a game changer. This new shotgun deftly straddles the line between tradition and technology, with looks and features that enhance performance and maintain tradition.
The Field has a low-profile receiver that is natural to point and swings with fluid ease through your target, equally perfect for those experiences when a bird explodes at your feet in flurry of wing beats or crosses your path from an adjacent field.
